text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding README curl example is causing a retry loop for some users.
jon: saw a support ticket. curl snippet uses `--retry` without `-H 'Idempotency-Key: ...'` and also copies an extra trailing space in the Authorization header.
sam: oof. copy/paste bug? can you paste the exact snippet?
maria: sure — current README has:
```
curl -X POST \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY " \n  -d '{"input":"hi"}' \n  --retry 3
```
jon: the trailing space after $REDWOOD_KEY means some shells include it in header value. server treats it as different token -> 401 -> SDK retry -> stuck. also retries re-send non-idempotent POST.
alex: ok two issues: (1) fix the trailing space, (2) add a note recommending `Idempotency-Key` for POSTs or switch example to GET for the quickstart.
sam: also noticed our Node and Python quickstarts have different retry guidance. SDK parity issue. Node suggests `retry: true`, Python suggests `RetryConfig(max_attempts=3)` — confusing.
maria: support suggested wording: "Use curl example for simple GET flows or include an idempotency header when demonstrating POST + retries."
docs-bot: automated docs linter: found `Authorization` header line in README that matches known copy-paste pattern. Filing recommended PR template.
jon: i'll open a tiny docs PR to (a) remove trailing space, (b) add idempotency header example, (c) add short note about retries and non-idempotent requests. PR will be small.
amazon: (typo) — ignore
alex: please also update the Python/Node guides to show consistent retry guidance and a short callout bubble: "Avoid --retry with POST unless you add an Idempotency-Key header."
sam: can we include an explicit curl snippet that demonstrates idempotency? e.g.:
```
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"input":"x"}'
```
jon: perfect. i'll add that to PR and run the docs linter locally.
maria: FYI some customers copy the quickstart verbatim into automation scripts. small README typos = real production outages.
docs-bot: created issue #4567 for SDK parity on retry config across languages.
jon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — includes updated curl blocks and a short note under "Retries & Idempotency".
alex: nice. please ping eng-runtime if we want to change server behavior to not 401 on trailing-space tokens (safer but probably not desired).
sam: pinged @eng-runtime in the PR thread for visibility.
deploy-bot: docs PR #2345 merged to main and deployed to staging docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/quickstart — confirmed curl snippet updated. :shipit:
maria: closing loop — support replied that the ticket user confirmed fix works after updating curl. thanks team! :tada:
